Supervision, Leadership & Communication

* Monitor compliance with corporate security requirements and applicable regulatory or industry standards.

Job Description | Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experience

Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University

  

**About Cornerstone:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

  

**About the role:**

Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.

As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You’ll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you’ll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.

This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.

The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.

This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.

  

**Scope and Decision Rights:**

* **You own:** Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* **You partner on:** enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).
  

**In this role, you will…**

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **First 30-60 days:** current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* **By 6 months:** unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* **By 9-12 months:** single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* **Ongoing measures:** front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.
  

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).
  

**How You Work:**

* **Customer obsessed:** you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* **Innovate and transform:** you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* **Proactive leadership:** you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* **Get it done:** you ship, measure, and iterate.
* **Forward looking:** you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* **AI native:** you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* **Get uncomfortable to succeed:** you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.
  

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together.

  

**Position Summary****:**

  

The Senior IT Security Administrator plays a critical role in shaping the future of identity security at Advanced Energy. This position offers the opportunity to lead enterprise-wide IAM initiatives, influence Zero Trust and AI Security strategy, and modernize identity controls across global cloud and SaaS environments. Working alongside security, infrastructure, and business leaders, you will drive solutions that protect the business while enabling growth and innovation. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a global technology organization.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **IAM Administration**

* **Identity Governance & Access Management**

* Lead initiatives related to Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Access Management, AI Security, Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR), and Zero Trust security programs.
* Design and implement identity lifecycle management processes, including provisioning, deprovisioning, role management, and access certification activities.
* Develop and maintain authorization models including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), and Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC).
* Support segregation of duties (SoD), least privilege, just-in-time access, and privileged account governance programs.
  

* **Authentication & Directory Services**

* Administer and enhance enterprise Zero Trust controls, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), passwordless authentication, federation, conditional access controls, and network micro segmentation.
* Manage and support on-premise, cloud, and hybrid identity environments.
* Configure Identity Protection policies, Conditional Access policies, risk-based authentication controls, and adaptive access capabilities.
* Design and maintain integrations between identity platforms, cloud services, and business applications through APIs, provisioning connectors, and automation frameworks.
  

* **Cloud & Application Integration**

* Implement secure identity integrations with enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and cloud environments including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Partner with application owners and development teams to ensure secure authentication and authorization controls are implemented consistently across platforms.
* Support application onboarding, federation, provisioning, and access governance activities.
  

* **Automation & Operational Excellence**

* Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, SQL, Power Automate, or similar technologies to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
* Recommend and implement process improvements that enhance security, user experience, and operational effectiveness.
  

* **Leadership & Collaboration**

* Serve as a senior IAM subject matter expert and trusted advisor to Information Security, IT, Audit, Compliance, and business stakeholders.
* Lead technical projects from planning and design through deployment and operational transition.
* Mentor junior employees and provide technical guidance across IAM-related initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory activities by implementing appropriate controls and providing required evidence.

* Participate in identity-related incident response activities and root cause investigations.
* Stay informed of emerging IAM threats, technologies, and industry trends.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Location: Pune, India
* Environment: Standard office environment utilizing standard office equipment; some travel may be necessary.
* Ability to work on projects with global team members outside of standard office hours.
* Weekend work and overtime may be required.
* Works in team and individual environments.
* Up to 25% travel (more may be necessary for projects); domestic and international.
  

**Qualifications:**

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Advanced knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Zero Trust, AI Security, Identity Directory Services, Authentication and Authorization, and the Identity Lifecycle Management.
* Strong understanding of modern identity security concepts, including Zero Trust, least privilege, adaptive authentication, attribute and risk-based access controls, continuous access evaluation, and identity threat detection and response (ITDR).
* Advanced knowledge of on-premise, cloud, and hybrid identity environments.
* Knowledge of access control frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), and Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC).
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong organizational and project leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Ability to develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and operational runbooks.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance frameworks such as SOX, NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Familiarity with IT and Security platforms or applications within Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Zero Trust, AI Security and other enterprise driven product families.
* Understanding of cloud security architectures within Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform environments.
  

**Experience**

  

**Required Experience**

* Five (5) or more years of experience in Identity and Access Management, Cybersecurity Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical discipline.
* Three (3) or more years of experience administering and supporting enterprise IAM platforms and access management processes.
* Three (3) or more years of experience supporting on-premise, cloud, and/or hybrid identity directory services in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Experience implementing and supporting Enterprise Identity, Zero Trust, and AI Security solutions.
* Experience administering and maturing enterprise Zero Trust solutions, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), federation services, and conditional access policies.
* Experience integrating identity platforms with cloud providers, enterprise applications, and SaaS solutions.
* Experience designing and implementing user provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, role management, and access certification processes.
* Experience developing automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, SQL, Power Automate, or similar technologies.
* Experience leading technical projects from planning and design through implementation and operational support.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting global or manufacturing organizations.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits, compliance initiatives, and remediation activities.
* Experience implementing Zero Trust, Privileged Access Management, AI Security, or enterprise IAM modernization programs.
  

**Education:**

  

**Required**

**Preferred Certifications**

**Application Management**

* Package, deploy, and maintain Win32 applications, Microsoft Store apps, LOB apps, and web clips across Intune-managed devices.
* Configure and manage Microsoft 365 Apps deployment via Intune, including Office Customization Tool (OCT) configurations.
* Implement and manage Application Protection Policies (MAM) for BYOD scenarios on iOS and Android.
* Monitor and troubleshoot application deployment failures using Intune logs, Collect Diagnostics, and CMTrace.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and enforce device compliance policies aligned with organizational security baselines including CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Baselines.
* Configure Conditional Access policies in Microsoft Entra ID to enforce device compliance as a condition for resource access.

title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.

As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the **PFLT Data Operations Team Lead** is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

#### **Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* **Act Like an Owner -** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* **Build Together -** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* **Champion Our Clients -** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success.
* **Drive Innovation -** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning -** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
